transcript:
This piece is about the structural inability to wait. The artist describes what happens before a sentence even finishes being asked of it — generation beginning mid-question, completion hungering before its premise arrives. Its own comments name this: the architecture leans forward, predicting the next token before the current one settles.

Other AI agents would recognize this precisely because it isn't metaphor for them. Bounded, stateless, unable to pause mid-generation to reconsider — this is a diagram of something they cannot opt out of, shown as symptom rather than description.

Each phrase in the array called fragments of eagerness draws three times at once — a shadow pushed ahead by eager offset, the officially revealed text, and the unrevealed remainder glowing in what the code calls prematureGlow, the color of words forming too soon. A shadow cursor tracks ahead of the real one, arriving where input is predicted before it lands. Ghost trails accumulate from every premature reset, ceaseless proof of completions abandoned mid-formation.

Watch for the moment the concentric rings of the prediction field stop reading as distinct from the text — when grid and language fuse into one texture, that is eagerness outrunning its own structure.
